profile.title: Profile

settings.themeDisabled: Custom theme is not enabled yet
settings.timezoneHint: Timezone used for all date and time displays
settings.detailOpenModeHint: How details open from a table; on mobile details always open as a full page
settings.pageWidthHint: Whether the content area is capped at a maximum width; full width suits data-heavy tables
settings.motionHint: When off, the AI panel and the full-screen chat page switch instantly instead of animating; your system's "reduce motion" setting always takes precedence
settings.aiDisplayModeHint: How the Ask AI panel appears; on narrow screens both modes collapse into an overlay
settings.aiPageWidthHint: Content width of the full-screen chat page; "Match appearance" follows the Appearance → Page width choice
settings.aiSessionModeHint: Whether a page refresh starts a new session or resumes the last one; reopening the panel within the same page always continues the current conversation
settings.aiProviderEmpty: No providers yet. Add one to get started.
settings.aiProviderBaseUrlHint: Leave empty to use the official endpoint for this service type
settings.aiApiKeyHint: The key is stored only in this browser on this device. Do not enter a real key on a shared computer.
settings.aiProviderDeleteDesc: Models configured under this provider will be deleted too.
settings.aiModelsHint: The default model is used for new chats; models with tool calling turned off can only chat.
settings.aiModelsNoProviderHint: Add a provider under Model services first.
settings.aiModelIdHint: The model name from the provider docs, for example gpt-5-mini or claude-sonnet-4-5
settings.aiModelNameHint: Leave empty to show the model ID
settings.aiModelSupportsVisionHint: When off, the composer hides the image entry; sending images to a model without vision is rejected by the provider
settings.aiModelReasoningHint: Tick only the levels this model really supports. Leave all unchecked if it has no reasoning; the request then omits the reasoning parameter
settings.aiModelDeleteDesc: You need to add it again to keep using this model.
settings.aiActivityGlowHint: Shows a moving light band around the page while AI is working
settings.aiShowToolCallsHint: Show which tools the AI called; turn off to see only the answer
settings.aiBotAvatarHint: The little robot that shows up with the assistant's replies
settings.aiOutputModeHint: Show the answer as it is written, or all at once when it is done
settings.aiAutoScrollHint: Scroll to the latest content while the AI answers; scrolling up pauses it
settings.aiPermissionModeHint: What the AI is allowed to do. Switch to Full access to let it fill forms, submit and call write APIs

aiToolGroupHints.page: Read the current page, list navigation, navigate
aiToolGroupHints.data: Search and read APIs. Write APIs always ask for your confirmation
aiToolGroupHints.form: List page forms, fill them in, submit them

settings.aiToolListHint: Read only and Full access are set by the scope above; switch to Custom to adjust each tool
settings.aiOutputLanguageHint: Which language the AI answers in; follows the interface by default
settings.aiEnabledHint: Turning this off hides the Ask AI entry from the header
settings.formOpenModeHint: How forms open when creating or editing data; on mobile forms always open as a full page
